name: r_into_d
label: Line R into RER D
about: Line R's trains no longer end at the surface of Gare de Lyon: they run on as RER D trains through Châtelet-Les Halles and Gare du Nord to Villiers-le-Bel, in the minutes of today's RER D trains (ASSUMPTION for the place where they end). Needs room for five more trains an hour between Gare de Lyon and Gare du Nord, that is RER D out of the tunnel it shares with RER B.
